observation: Fresh main validates run changesets only as strings even though every repository changeset identity accepted by ChangesetStore.file is constrained to lowercase cs-<hex>. A durable run can therefore claim arbitrary string references that downstream ChangesetStore consumers will deterministically reject.
changes: Reuse the existing ChangesetStore identity syntax at the run changeset-ledger read/write boundary.
Publish the same lowercase cs-<hex> reference pattern in North Star Run v0.2.
Do not add cross-store existence checks or tighten to the current 20-hex generator width because those would impose stronger lifecycle or identity policy than the existing store accepts.

verification.focused_reference_replay: 4/4 PASS against the exact patched RunStore: arbitrary string, uppercase prefix/suffix and empty suffix are rejected; ChangesetStore-compatible cs-1/cs-a0f9 remain accepted.
verification.writer_parity: NorthStarRunner appends only cs.id values produced by ChangesetStore.stage, while ChangesetStore.file accepts /^cs-[a-f0-9]+$/.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remains transiently unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted/full-suite success is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle closes run-ledger reference syntax parity only. Referential existence, lifecycle coupling, append-only history and authenticated provenance remain separate boundaries.
